1.w: But understand this, that in the last days difficult times will come.

2.w: For people will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,

3.w: unloving, irreconcilable, slanderers, without self-control, savage, opposed to what is good,

4.w: treacherous, reckless, conceited, loving pleasure rather than loving God.

5.w: They will maintain the outward appearance of religion but will have repudiated its power. So avoid people like these.

6.w: For some of these insinuate themselves into households and captivate weak women who are overwhelmed with sins and led along by various passions.

7.w: Such women are always seeking instruction, yet never able to arrive at a knowledge of the truth.

8.w: And just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these people—who have warped minds and are disqualified in the faith —also oppose the truth.

9.w: But they will not go much further, for their foolishness will be obvious to everyone, just like it was with Jannes and Jambres.

10.w: You, however, have followed my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my endurance,

11.w: as well as the persecutions and sufferings that happened to me in Antioch, in Iconium, and in Lystra. I endured these persecutions, and the Lord delivered me from them all.

12.w: Now in fact all who want to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

13.w: But evil people and charlatans will go from bad to worse, deceiving others and being deceived themselves.

14.w: You, however, must continue in the things you have learned and are confident about. You know who taught you

15.w: and how from infancy you have known the holy writings, which are able to give you wisdom for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

16.w: Every scripture is inspired by God and useful for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,

17.w: that the person dedicated to God may be capable and equipped for every good work.
